utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, I’ve got the school parking lot after drop-off noted for now, but I’m waiting on a double-check before I lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that’s a good placeholder, and just let me know once you’ve got the double-check so I can finalize the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ve got it marked as the school parking lot after drop-off for now, and I’ll update you as soon as I get the confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far, but Rosa’s collecting repair needs now, so if you’ve got something to add I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—tell Rosa I’ll spread the word and get a few neighbors to send over any repair needs this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still only hearing this secondhand, but I’ll make sure Rosa knows you’re helping spread the word this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, we’re still short a sturdy ladder and a couple of hammers, but gloves should be covered if Oren remembers to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I can ask around this evening and see if anyone can lend a ladder or a couple of hammers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a big help, thanks—if anyone can spare extra work gloves too, I’ll note them down just in case.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll bring the gloves and check on that ladder, and I’ll aim for a time outside Faye’s school-run windows.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—before we lock that in, can you confirm which Oak house is actually signed up and how many trash bags and tool kits we still need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—I'm not sure on the Oak house or the counts offhand; can you nudge Cleo to confirm while I make sure I’ve got the gloves and maybe the ladder?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive as long as it’s outside my school drop-off and pickup windows—roughly 7:30 to 8:30 and 2:30 to 3:30. I think they’re staging in the school parking lot after drop-off, but I can double-check.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Faye—I’m pretty sure it starts at 10 on Saturday, so that should work, but I’d still want somebody to confirm the parking lot part because I lose track of these details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That timing works for me, and I can double-check that they’re using the school parking lot before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s shaping up nicely, Uli—Sam’s set for Saturday morning at the community center, and I’m bringing my toolbox and ladder for the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good. I’ll be there early at the quiet check-in table for a bit, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That helps a lot, Uli—I appreciate you covering check-in early, and I’ll come by with the toolbox once I get there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any word on the signup list yet? I’m still out on errands, but I can pitch in once I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet—who’s handling intake, and where exactly are we setting the drop-off table?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think Eli’s handling the signups and logistics, but I haven’t heard the exact table spot yet—once he checks in this afternoon, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m putting the signup list and repair jobs in order now, Vik, and I should have a clear schedule by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Eli — I’ve been telling folks we’re set up by the community center, and I’ll pass along that you’ll have the repair schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Vik — once I’ve got the names and jobs lined up, I’ll bring the schedule by the community center so everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m all set for Saturday morning, Tess—I’ll start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything that needs testing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful, Sam—folks have really been bringing things by, and Mara’s due later with a box of screws. I’ll keep spreading the word so you’ve got plenty to sort.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—I’ll get the tools organized first thing, and I’ll keep an eye out for Mara’s screws when she drops them off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still not comfortable counting on it until someone confirms who’s organizing intake and exactly where the drop-off table will be.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly—can you check who’s actually running intake and where the drop-off table will be before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around, but until we have one named person for intake and a confirmed drop-off spot, I wouldn’t plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem—meet us at the community shed at 9 and take intake, logging each item and what repair it needs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll be at the community shed at 9 and take intake, logging each item and what repair it needs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center, and we’d be glad to have you if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just point me where you need hands most, and I’ll bring a few small tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Bo—if you can, start with the bike table when you get there, and your small tools would definitely come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m putting the signup list and repair schedule together now, so once I’ve got the jobs sorted I’ll share it around and we can keep the day running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Eli—once you share the list, I can jump on the tool table or help with the bikes, whichever still needs it most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad you’re here, Dane—once I finish the list this afternoon, I’ll put you where the need is greatest, likely the bikes or the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by the repair drive outside pickup windows, and I still think they’re staging it in the school parking lot after drop-off, but I’ll double-check for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—I've got Maple at 9 in my notes, so just ping me if that changed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do—I’m free after drop-off, so I’ll double-check whether it’s the school lot or Maple and let you know if anything’s different.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning, Gus—can you take intake at the shed at 9 and keep a simple list of what comes in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Leo—I can handle intake at the shed at 9 and keep a simple list of whatever folks bring in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Gus—just note the item, who brought it, and whether it needs testing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help, Rosa—I can start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything that needs testing Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Sam—thank you. Go ahead and start with the donated tools Saturday morning, and set aside anything questionable so we can test it before check-in opens.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa—I’ll get there Saturday morning and sort through everything before check-in opens.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I lock anything in, can you confirm the exact sign-ups from both blocks and the current counts for gloves, trash bags, and tool kits?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m sorry, Hana—I don’t have the exact counts on me right now. Rosa’s got the sign-up sheet, and I only know I’m on the early quiet check-in shift for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli—then let’s wait until Rosa has the sign-up sheet, because I don’t want to commit without the exact houses and supply counts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—I’ve got you down for tools and spare parts, and I’ll let a few neighbors know to bring anything useful by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Quinn—right now we still need a sturdy ladder, a couple of hammers, and extra work gloves, so send folks our way if they’ve got any.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word right away and ask around for a sturdy ladder, a couple of hammers, and extra work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, who can own intake, and where exactly do you want the drop-off table set so we can lock this down?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If Sam can own intake, I’d want the drop-off table right by the community center entrance so it’s easy to find and keep track of what comes in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—if Sam’s taking intake, can you confirm with Sam today and make sure we’ve got a sign-in sheet ready at the community center entrance?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: How’s it looking now with the repair drive? I’m still out on errands, but send me the signup list when you can and I’ll see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still waiting on firm details—can you confirm who’s actually organizing it and where we’re meant to meet before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: From what I’ve heard, Eli’s handling the signups and planning, and Gus is bringing tools to help with repairs; I’m still out on errands, but let’s wait for Eli to confirm the meetup spot this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling people Nell’s checking with Mara for the details, but the repair drive’s set up by the community center and folks are already sorting tools and patching bikes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That lines up with what I’ve heard—we’ve got four volunteers from our block and three from the next, and we still need a couple more bike helpers plus someone steady on the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good to know—I’ll keep telling people we still need a couple more bike helpers and someone steady at the tool table over by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks—I can definitely bring the gloves, and I’ll check on that ladder and round up a couple of hammers too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful, Oren—every bit helps, and I heard Mara’s bringing a box of screws later too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that helps—I'll bring the gloves for sure, and if I don't forget, I'll check the shed for the ladder and round up those hammers too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center, and we’d be glad to have you if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—I can probably stop by for a bit. Do you know if neighbors usually bring their own tools, or will there be some there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’ll have some basic tools there, but if you’ve got favorites, feel free to bring them along. Even just stopping by for a bit helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Nell, I’ve got it noted as the school parking lot after drop-off for now, though Faye’s double-checking the location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps — I’d only heard bits through Mara, so I’ll pass along that it’s the school parking lot for now and mention Faye’s still confirming.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Nell—please tell folks it’s the school parking lot after drop-off for now, and I’ll update everyone if Faye confirms anything different.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
